name: District of Columbia
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); the OCTO District Government Web Style and Standards still say WCAG 2.0 AA plus Section 508.

laws.summary: Gives OCTO authority to set and enforce District IT policy, including the web standards.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: OCTO District Government Web Style and Standards

applies_to: All District government websites and applications on the DC.gov portal. DC is a 'State' under ADA Title II (42 U.S.C. 12103) with population over 50,000.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).

requires: WCAG 2.0 AA minimum, AAA where possible, and Section 508 (OCTO standards)
ODR Web and Social Media Accessibility Technical Assistance Manual as implementation guidance
Agency ADA Coordinators handle accommodation requests
mobile: implied — OCTO standards cover 'websites and applications'; the federal rule covers mobile apps explicitly.
procurement: No District accessibility contract clause found.
enforcement: Report to DC.Gov; accommodation and complaints via agency ADA Coordinators, the Office of Disability Rights, or the Office of Human Rights; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The OCTO page also cites the 'Disability Discrimination Act' (likely a legacy template reference). No District statute setting WCAG 2.1 was found. The D.C. Code citation comes from search results.
